o.text: From Proto-Turkic *siŕ. Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰾𐰃𐰕 (siz, “you (plural)”), Chuvash эсир (es̬ir).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آردولمق (arzulamaq). By surface analysis, arzu + -la.
From Proto-Turkic *sīĺč- (“to swell”). Cognate with Turkish şişmek, see there for more.
